Name: CP - Fatal Frame Camera Obscura Plushie Pack
Author: bunreee
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod adds [/color][color=#00ff00]6 large plushies [/color][color=#d4d4d8]of various Camera Obscuras from the franchise Fatal Frame. These are replacements for the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Lg._Futan_Bear]large Futan Bear [/url]but they are their own [/color][color=#00ff00]separate furniture.[/color][color=#d4d4d8] [/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]To my knowledge, these [/color][color=#00ff00]cannot be set on top of any tables [/color][color=#d4d4d8]because of their large size (I did not try every table so I could be wrong). I wanted to add a smaller size of each plushie, but the majority looked bad when scaled down due to the pixel reduction in Photopea.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Buy the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Furniture_Catalogue]Furniture Catalogue[/url] from Robin's Carpenter Shop for $200,000g after upgrading the farmhouse[/*]
[/list][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/e/e8/Furniture_Catalogue.png[/img]
   2. Open the catalogue by right clicking it outside of your inventory (on pc) and under the last section in the menu, scroll down until you see the furniture labeled:
- FF II Camera Obscura
- FF Movie Camera Obscura
- FF V Camera Obscura
- FF I Camera Obscura
- FF Spirit Camera Obscura
- FF Ren Hojo Camera Obscura 
[left][/left]
